definitions_implemented.GDD_LF_48_59: (1) B is a family of subsets of X (called blocks), each having cardinality in K; (2) each block of B intersects any given group in at most one point; (3) each t-subset of X from t distinct groups is contained in exactly one block.
definitions_implemented.PPC_PC_LF_69_70: A partial parallel class (PPC) of Y is a collection of pairwise disjoint blocks contained in Y. A parallel class (PC) of Y is a PPC that partitions Y.
definitions_implemented.KF_LF_237_240: A Kirkman frame F(2,3,v{m}) (as in [18]), briefly by KF(m^v), is a GDD(2,3,mv) of type m^v (X,G,B) such that the block set B can be partitioned into subsets P_r, r in R, each P_r being a PC of X \ G for some group G in G. A KF(m^v) exists if and only if m = 0 (mod 2), v >= 4 and m(v-1) = 0 (mod 3) (see [17]).
definitions_implemented.derived_design_LF_241_242: Let (X,G,A) be a GDD(3,4,mv) of type m^v. For any x in X, let A_x = {A\{x} : x in A, A in A}. Then the derived design (X\G, G\{G}, A_x) is a GDD(2,3,m(v-1)) of type m^(v-1).
definitions_implemented.FDGDD_LF_246_247: we use FDGDD(3,4,v{m}) to denote a GDD(3,4,mv) of type m^v whose derived design at every point is a KF(m^(v-1)).
definitions_implemented.instantiation: v=5 groups, m=18: X has 90 points; at x in G_x the derived design lives on the 72 points X\G_x with the other four groups; a KF class is a PC of (X\G_x)\G_j for some j != group(x): 18 pairwise disjoint triples covering 54 points. Counting forces 648 derived triples, 36 classes and 9 classes per missed group; the source does not state these counts, the checker verifies them as forced consistency checks.
definitions_implemented.format_D_LF_126_131_of_lane_README: GDD34 KIND k m / GROUPS + k lines of m points / BLOCKS + lines of 4 points / per point x a section POINT x with classes FRAME j (j = index of the missed group, != group of x) followed by triples

checker.independence: written by this desk from the source definitions and README Format D text; no lane checker, producer, seed or mutation code read, imported or executed
checker.strict_grammar: ASCII [0-9A-Z space LF]; final LF; no blank lines/comments/tabs/CR; single spaces; integers 0|[1-9][0-9]*; POINT sections exactly 0..89 in order; >=1 class per section expected by F04/F08

FORMAT.description: file parses under the strict canonical Format D grammar

C01_HEADER.description: header is "GDD34 FDGDD k m" with (k, m) equal to the target

C02_GROUPS_SHAPE.description: k group lines, each with exactly m labels (type m^k)

C03_POINT_LABEL_RANGE.description: every point label (groups, blocks, POINT headers, triples) lies in 0..km-1

C05_BLOCK_IS_4_SUBSET.description: every block line lists 4 distinct points (K = {4}, LF 52)

C06_BLOCK_TRANSVERSE.description: every block meets each group in at most one point (LF 53)

C07_BLOCK_NOT_IN_GROUP_PAIR_UNION.description: no block lies inside the union of two groups (redundant with C06; checked separately)

C09_BLOCK_COUNT.description: number of block lines equals C(k,3) m^3 / 4 (forced by C10)

C10_TRANSVERSE_TRIPLES_EXACTLY_ONCE.description: multiset of 3-subsets of blocks equals the set of all transverse 3-subsets (exact universe equality, LF 59)

D02_DERIVED_IS_GDD_2_3.description: at every x, (X\G_x, G\{G_x}, A_x) is a GDD(2,3,(k-1)m) of type m^(k-1): derived triples are transverse 3-subsets of X\G_x and every cross pair lies in exactly one (exact universe equality)

F01_POINT_SECTIONS.description: exactly one POINT section for each x, in order 0..km-1

F02_FRAME_LABEL_VALID.description: every FRAME label j is a group index 0..k-1 other than the group of x

F03_FRAME_TRIPLE_IS_3_SUBSET.description: every listed triple consists of 3 distinct points

F04_CLASSES_PARTITION_DERIVED.description: at every x the listed triples over all classes equal A_x as multisets (each derived triple exactly once, nothing else)

F05_CLASS_PAIRWISE_DISJOINT.description: the triples of each class are pairwise disjoint

F06_CLASS_IS_PC_OF_X_MINUS_GX_AND_ONE_GR.description: each class is a PC of (X\G_x)\G for some group G != G_x (KF, LF 237-239)

F07_FRAME_LABEL_MATCHES_MISSED_GROUP.description: the declared FRAME label equals the group the class misses

F09_DECLARED_MISSED_GROUP_COUNTS.description: at every x each group other than G_x is the declared label of exactly m/2 classes (forced)
